To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the C proteins of the Pasteureulla haemolytica (LktC) and Escherichia (HlyC) leukotoxins are nonreciprocally complementing and are required for toxin activation.
the C proteins (HlyC and LktC) of the E. coli hemolysins and Pasteurella leukotoxin operons are required for toxin activation, and that the C proteins are not functionally interchangeable.
the LktC and HylC proteins are nonreciprocal activators of the respective LktA and HlyA proteins.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanism of activation of LktA by LktC and HylA by HlyC.
the activation of the cytotoxic proteins (A) encoded by the leukotoxin and the hemolysin genes by their respective C protein (LktC or HylC).
the activation of leukotoxins by their C proteins.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the leukotoxin and the hemolysin are activated in a nonreciprocal fashion.
the C proteins are not interchangeable in terms of their role in toxin activation and that the C proteins of the leukotoxin and the hemolysin are not identical.
LktC and HylC are nonreciprocal complementing activators for the respective leukotoxin and the hemolysin.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the C proteins (HlyC and LktC) are essential for the production of active toxin and that the C proteins are responsible for the target cell specificity of the leukotoxin and the hemolysin.
the leukotoxin and the hemolysin are activated by their respective C genes in a nonreciprocal manner.
LktC is a leukotoxin activator and HlyC is a hemolysin activator.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the C protein is required for the production of a functional toxin.
the LktC and HylC proteins are nonreciprocally functional in complementing the cytolytic activities of the LktA and HylA proteins, respectively.
the C proteins of leukotoxin (LktC) and hemolysins (HlyC) play a crucial role in the activation of their respective toxins.
